bugs.name: Profile repository search treats "%" and "_" as wildcards and lists repositories that do not contain them
bugs.summary: The query '%' returns the repository 'harbor-handbook' (and '_' returns every repo as well). The characters are sent as SQL LIKE wildcards instead of literal text, so a search that should match nothing lists repositories whose names/descriptions do not contain the searched text at all. URL after searching: /eval?tab=repositories&q=%25&sort=recentupdate. (on /eval?tab=repositories)
bugs.expected: Searching for '%' (or '_') should find no repository, because no repository name or description contains that character; the page should show 'No matching results found.' like it does for any other non-matching query (e.g. 'zzz-no-match').
bugs.actual: The query '%' returns the repository 'harbor-handbook' (and '_' returns every repo as well). The characters are sent as SQL LIKE wildcards instead of literal text, so a search that should match nothing lists repositories whose names/descriptions do not contain the searched text at all. URL after searching: /eval?tab=repositories&q=%25&sort=recentupdate.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and open https://5503-io7gkkxhkz5bckp0f49nq.e2b.app/eval?tab=repositories
In the 'Search repos...' box type a single '%' and press Enter (or click the magnifier)
Note the result list
Repeat with a single '_' as the query

bugs.summary: A bare white page containing only the text \"Invalid CSRF token.\" is shown (HTTP 400 on POST /user/settings). There is no site header, no message explaining that the session ended and no sign-in form or link — the visitor is stranded with no way on. (on /user/settings)
bugs.expected: The stale form submit should end with the visitor being sent to the sign-in page (as every other protected page does when signed out) with a readable message, and no profile change made.
bugs.actual: A bare white page containing only the text \"Invalid CSRF token.\" is shown (HTTP 400 on POST /user/settings). There is no site header, no message explaining that the session ended and no sign-in form or link — the visitor is stranded with no way on.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1.
Open https://5503-i7o8fz8bj9kf9tmt09ztp.e2b.app/user/settings in a second tab (tab B) and leave it there.
In the first tab, open the account menu at the top right and click "Sign Out" (the visitor is signed out).
Back in tab B (still showing the old, signed-in profile settings form), type a value into the "Location" field, e.g. agent11-stale-signout, and click the "Update Profile" button.
